name: cell-attribute
body: A cell attribute a template declares in its `body.tables.cell_attributes` list with the usual field descriptors (domain.value.field): `name`, `type` (the boolean and enum field types of domain.value.field-type) and an enum's `variants`. A declared attribute is set in a cell by an attribute group or a short-hand (table-cell-attributes) and appears in the cell's `attrs` map, typed by its declaration (table-layout-context). `br` is reserved and is never a declared cell attribute. An attribute a cell uses that its template does not declare is an error with a closest-match suggestion over the declared attributes; a bare name that is both a declared boolean attribute and an enum variant, or a variant of more than one declared enum, is a template load error (table-cell-attributes).
